name: Triple Royal Gold
review:
Triple Royal Gold is a 3x3 cabinet-style slot with up to 27 ways, wilds and avalanches. Collect the letters B-O-N-U-S to trigger the bonus, where the multiplier can reach 27x.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 5,000x cap and a 96.41% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
